verdict.rationale: Unleash exposes an MCP server so external LLM coding assistants can manage flags (unleash-docs-7, unleash-probe-2, unleash-probe-rt-2), but this is the reverse of the story — it makes Unleash a tool for outside agents, not a built-in assistant living inside the Unleash product that users delegate tasks to. No evidence of an in-product AI assistant/chat feature for creating rollouts, analyzing flags, etc.
